name: memory-base
description: Memory Base for Claude Code: the agent's and the user's cards and the repo's handoffs at session start, and the verbatim turn record kept beside them.

url.title: REST URL
url.description: Base URL of the memory-base REST API that the hooks call.

mcp_url.title: MCP URL
mcp_url.description: URL of the memory-base MCP server (streamable HTTP) that provides the memory tools.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: The memory-base API key for this agent, sent as X-API-Key; held in the secure store.

author.title: Author
author.description: The author slug this agent writes under and reads by default; sent as the X-Author header on every request.

user_entity.title: User entity
user_entity.description: Slug of the user's own entity (kind person), as list_entities shows it; its card is delivered at session start. Empty: no user card.

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: A registered namespace for this agent's turns and for the facts on its session-start cards; empty means `default`. Register a new one first (the connect-agent skill shows how): the server refuses every turn in an unregistered namespace.
